name: expert_abh_bh_stoch
summary: This EA uses the CBH_BH_Stoch custom signal filter, which combines a Stochastic oscillator with a Moving Average, to generate buy/sell signals within the MetaQuotes standard expert advisor framework. It employs fixed lot sizing for money management and no trailing stop. Entry and exit are governed by configurable signal threshold levels.
summary_zh: 该EA使用CBH_BH_Stoch自定义信号过滤器，该过滤器结合了随机振荡器和移动平均线，在MetaQuotes标准EA框架内生成买卖信号。资金管理采用固定手数，不使用追踪止损。入场和出场由可配置的信号阈值水平控制。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略基于CBH_BH_Stoch信号过滤器，它将随机振荡器（Stochastic）与移动平均线（MA）相结合来判断市场动量方向。入场条件依赖随机指标K值（周期47）和D值（周期9）的交叉或超买超卖区域信号，并辅以MA（周期5）确认趋势方向。出场条件由信号阈值控制，开仓阈值为40，平仓阈值为20，当信号强度低于平仓阈值时触发平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数模式（默认0.1手），不做动态调整。资金管理使用CMoneyFixedLot类，基于固定百分比（10%）和固定手数进行风险控制，但未设置止损和止盈水平（均为0.0），这意味着出场完全依赖信号反转，缺乏硬性风险保护。此外，该EA不使用追踪止损，盈利头寸无法自动锁定利润。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the CBH_BH_Stoch signal filter, which combines a Stochastic oscillator with a Moving Average to determine market momentum direction. Entry conditions rely on Stochastic K-line (period 47) and D-line (period 9) crossover or overbought/oversold zone signals, confirmed by a 5-period MA for trend direction. Exit conditions are governed by signal thresholds: the open threshold is 40 and the close threshold is 20, triggering position closure when signal strength drops below the close threshold. Position sizing uses a fixed lot model (default 0.1 lots) with no dynamic adjustment. Money management employs the CMoneyFixedLot class based on a fixed percentage (10%) and fixed lot size, but no stop loss or take profit levels are set (both at 0.0), meaning exits depend entirely on signal reversal without hard risk protection. Furthermore, the EA does not use trailing stops, so profitable positions cannot automatically lock in gains.

parameters.description_en: Close signal threshold [0...100], close when signal falls below

parameters.name: Signal_PriceLevel
parameters.description_en: Trade execution price level, 0 for market execution

parameters.name: Signal_StopLevel
parameters.description_en: Stop loss level (points), 0 means no SL set

parameters.description: 随机指标价格应用类型

pros: 使用标准MetaQuotes EA框架，代码结构清晰规范，易于维护和扩展
随机指标结合移动平均线双重确认，减少虚假信号
信号阈值可配置，允许灵活调整入场和出场的敏感度
pros_en: Uses the standard MetaQuotes EA framework with clean code structure, making it easy to maintain and extend
Stochastic oscillator combined with Moving Average provides dual confirmation, reducing false signals
Configurable signal thresholds allow flexible adjustment of entry and exit sensitivity
cons: 未设置止损和止盈（均为0.0），在信号失效时缺乏硬性风险保护
不使用追踪止损，盈利头寸无法在趋势反转前锁定利润
固定手数策略不考虑账户规模和波动性变化，资金管理过于简单
cons_en: No stop loss or take profit set (both at 0.0), lacking hard risk protection when signals fail
No trailing stop used, so profitable positions cannot lock in gains before trend reversal
Fixed lot sizing does not account for account size or volatility changes, making money management overly simplistic
improvements: 添加止损和止盈参数，提供硬性风险保护，避免单笔交易过大亏损
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和市场波动性（如ATR）调整手数
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters to provide hard risk protection and prevent excessive losses on single trades
Introduce dynamic position sizing that adjusts lot size based on account balance and market volatility (e.g., ATR)

risk_points: 止损和止盈均为0，交易完全依赖信号平仓，极端行情下可能造成巨大亏损
无新K线检查机制（Expert_EveryTick=false但非逐tick），可能在非最佳时点交易
固定手数不随账户变化调整，长期运行可能导致仓位与账户规模不匹配
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit are both zero, trades rely entirely on signal-based exits which can cause massive losses in extreme market conditions
No new bar check mechanism, potentially trading at non-optimal price points
Fixed lot size does not adjust with account changes, leading to potential mismatch between position size and account size over long-term operation
